summary: As second hand slips past six sounds of mistral whisks slow and minstrels of morning beckon to a new clock a New Day 22, maybe like 21 24, 7, or 51 but birds do sing again, #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
As second
hand slips
past six
sounds of
mistral
whisks slow
and minstrels
of
morning beckon
to a new clock
a New Day
22, maybe like 21
24, 7, or 51
but birds
do sing again,
#smallpoems
